description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) for different models across several datasets. The horizontal axis represents the dataset, labeled “Dataset”, with categories including SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, presented in that order. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%), labeled “F1 Score (%)”, with a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  For each dataset, there are three bars representing different models: “MADLLM w/o prompt pool” (light green), “MADLLM w/o feature embedding” (blue), and “MADLLM w/ skip embedding” (purple). For the SMD dataset, the “MADLLM w/o prompt pool” bar reaches approximately 96%, the “MADLLM w/o feature embedding” bar reaches approximately 89%, and the “MADLLM w/ skip embedding” bar reaches approximately 92%.  For the WADI dataset, the “MADLLM w/o prompt pool” bar reaches approximately 72%, the “MADLLM w/o feature embedding” bar reaches approximately 75%, and the “MADLLM w/ skip embedding” bar reaches approximately 70%. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each group containing the three model variations. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized.
